title: 熱流体工学
subtitle: Introduction to Thermofluids
keywords: Engine System 2.Energy Exchange Process 3.Jet Engine Cycle 4.Piston Engine Cycle 5.Heat Transfer
educationalGoal: Students will: (1)learn the energy exchange process in jet engines (2)learn the energy exchange process in piston engines (3)learn the heat transfer process
advice: This is a basic course on thermofluids.We will cover the following materials: 1.Lecture on engine system and principle of energy exchange process, exercises. 2.Lecture on piston engine cycle and performance calculation,exercises. 3.Lecture on jet engine cycle and performance calculation,exercises. 4.Lecture on Fourier law on heat conduction and application to flat plate model,exercises. 5.Lecture on non dimensional parameter governing heat convection and application to flat plate model,exercises. Students will also learn about advanced issues such as radiation. Students are expected to understand the meaning of terms and formulas. Students are expected to solve advanced exerciseson their own. Students should be aware of the teacher7s instructions in the class,because the schdules of quizzes,tests and reports may change as the class progresses.
requiredKnowledge: Acquisition of Fluid Dynamics and Thermodynamics Sufficient skill in mathematics(especially differntial/integral calculations) Know how to use a calculator

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain basic concept of energy exchange.
Be able to explain jet engine and piston engine cycle calculations.
Be able to calculate basic heat conduction and heat convection.
